qualification: local pinned-fixture correctness and production-admission recovery evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

admission.boundedRule: Only the complete one-instruction, one-statement block at 0xffffffff815cab95 with the measured five-byte memory SETE operation is admitted.
admission.implementation: Tier one materializes pending flags, stages the equality predicate, and performs one final transactional byte write. A failed write publishes neither architectural state nor memory.
admission.deferred: All other memory SETcc sites, predicates, encodings, and block shapes remain on the legacy path.

priorFailure.interpretationAfterIsolation: The candidate encountered the byte-revalidation protection hole later isolated by the CR3 control experiment; the failure did not originate in the measured SETE semantics.

verification.focusedGate: 45 tests in DoryARM64Tier1JITTests passed with both the recovered memory-SETcc and CR3 slices.
verification.dbtAndPCGate: 1,445 tests in 171 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent.
verification.differentialCoverage: True and false equality outcomes match the interpreter at the measured high-canonical block, including a chained pending-flags producer; the same operation at an adjacent RIP declines.
verification.rollbackCoverage: A failed transactional byte write preserves the original architectural state and memory.
verification.coherencyCoverage: The byte-revalidation and shared-code reuse regressions pass with the admission enabled.

unmatchedRecoveryComparison.interpretation: The executions have different interrupt, compilation, trace, and instruction totals. The elapsed difference is reported for completeness and is not a performance claim.

interpretation: The exact memory-SETcc candidate failed before the general code-page reprotection repair and completed the authenticated workload after that repair, with its measured site absent from the retained negative-cache sample. The bounded admission is restored. A05.2 remains open because 125,223 of 224,168 full-run tier-one attempts still declined.
limitations: The complete workload evidence contains one recovery run on one local Apple M2 Pro.
The exact-site admission is tied to the pinned kernel and does not establish general memory-SETcc coverage.
The negative-cache sampler is capped and proves absence only from the retained visible list.
This evidence establishes no performance delta and does not satisfy G1-G5.
